grammar.title: Potential complement: V + 得/不 + 下
grammar.explanation: 得 or 不 plus 下 after a verb asks whether something has enough room or capacity — "fit, hold". 得下 (de xià) means there's enough space, and 不下 (bu xià) means there isn't.

grammar.title: Purpose with 为了
grammar.pattern: 为了 + 目的，(主语) + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 为了 (wèile) introduces the goal or purpose of an action, like English "in order to". It sits at the very start of the sentence, before the goal, and the main clause with the actual action follows. Unlike 因为...所以, 为了 gives a reason you are aiming for, not a cause that already happened.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì dì yī gè dào.
sentences.en: She's always the first to arrive.
